proofs.pim.data-models.families-have-models: every declared family has a GroupType 2 data model on its category with at least one product, and at least two families are declared

proofs.pim.data-models.products-without-model: no active product sits outside every data model
proofs.pim.field-placement.global-fields-filled: every custom global product field (EcomProductField, not standard) carries a value on at least 50% of the products in scope (checkboxes and computed fields are not judged)
proofs.pim.field-placement.ruling.one-category-: at most one attribute category carries fields
proofs.pim.data-sets.data-set: at least one GroupType 3 data set exists
proofs.pim.data-sets.defaults: at least one default value is stored on a data model or data set
proofs.pim.field-types.declared-typing: every declared attribute is stored on a field type that fits its kind, and at least 12 attributes are declared
proofs.pim.field-types.type-spread: the category fields use at least 7 distinct field types (the five text lengths count as one)
proofs.pim.field-types.text-share: at most 40 percent of the category fields are plain text
proofs.pim.field-types.declared-have-values: every declared category attribute has a value on at least one product

proofs.pim.field-units.groups-valid: every unit group in use has a base unit that is one of its own units
proofs.pim.field-units.unit-in-label: no category field label carries a unit in brackets
proofs.pim.unit-rules-per-language.rules: at least one field shows a different unit for a language, and the unit resolves
proofs.pim.unit-rules-per-language.ruling.one-l: product rows exist in at most one language
proofs.pim.list-fields.declared-options: every declared choice field has at least 2 options, and at least 3 choice attributes are declared
proofs.pim.list-fields.multi-select: at least one list field is a multi select (checkbox list or multi-select list)
proofs.pim.list-fields.values-resolve: every value stored on a list field is one of the field's option values
proofs.pim.field-rules.declared-required: every attribute declared required is marked required on its field, and at least 2 are declared
proofs.pim.field-validation.pattern: at least one field carries a validation pattern
proofs.pim.field-scope.declared-scope: every attribute declared per language or per variant allows that difference on its field, and at least 2 are declared
proofs.pim.field-scope.ruling.one-language-no-v: no second language and no variant row exists
proofs.pim.computed-fields.provider-field: at least one field is built on a field type with a provider
proofs.pim.field-display-groups.groups: at least 2 named display groups each hold 2 or more fields
proofs.pim.field-display-groups.unnamed-groups: every display group has a name (on the group, or a translation in the default language keyed by its id or its system name)
proofs.pim.field-display-groups.ruling.no-shop-: no storefront shop and no feed exists
proofs.pim.identifiers.number-missing: every active product and variant has a number (a master with variants is exempt: the platform blanks it)
proofs.pim.identifiers.number-duplicates: no product number is used twice
proofs.pim.gtin.ean-share: at least 50 percent of the active products carry a GTIN on ProductEAN
proofs.pim.manufacturers.product-share: at least 80 percent of the active products name a manufacturer that exists
proofs.pim.sales-units.product-units: at least 2 product unit rows exist (a product with its units and quantities)
proofs.pim.variants.groups-with-options: at least one variant group has 2 or more options
proofs.pim.variants.masters: at least 2 products have variant rows
proofs.pim.variants.inactive-variants: no variant row was left with a NULL active flag
proofs.pim.variants.variant-numbers: every variant row has its own number
proofs.pim.bom.bom-products: at least one product of type BOM has 2 or more component lines
proofs.pim.bom.lines-resolve: every BOM line names a component product or a group that exists
proofs.pim.product-relations.relation-groups: at least 2 relation groups exist (two kinds of relation)
proofs.pim.product-relations.relations-resolve: every relation names two products and a relation group that exist
proofs.pim.dynamic-relations.groups: at least one dynamic relation group exists
proofs.pim.images.image-share: at least 90 percent of the active products have an image
proofs.pim.images.images-without-default: no product has images and no default image
proofs.pim.documents.document-categories: at least 2 asset categories that accept pdf each hold at least one asset
proofs.pim.documents.products-with-documents: at least 10 products carry a document
proofs.pim.documents.category-names: every asset category in use has a name in the default language
proofs.pim.completeness-rules.rules: at least 2 completeness rules each list 3 or more fields
proofs.pim.completeness-rules.models-without-ru: every data model that holds products has a completeness rule assigned
proofs.pim.workflow.states: one workflow has at least 3 states
proofs.pim.workflow.transitions: at least 3 transitions connect states that exist
proofs.pim.workflow.attached: the workflow is attached to at least one group
proofs.pim.workflow.states-in-use: products stand in at least 2 different states
proofs.pim.workflow.notification: at least one state sends a notification that has recipients
proofs.pim.product-queries.shared-queries: at least 5 saved product queries exist in the shared query folder
proofs.pim.dashboards.dashboard: at least one Products dashboard has 4 or more widgets
proofs.pim.dashboards.widget-queries: every widget on a Products dashboard that names a query names one that exists
proofs.pim.workspaces.workspaces: at least 2 workspaces each have a level
proofs.pim.workspaces.empty-workspaces: no workspace was saved with zero levels
proofs.pim.workspaces.completeness-level: at least one workspace level shows completeness
proofs.pim.email-notifications.notifications: at least one PIM notification has a recipient
proofs.pim.field-permissions.field-permissions: at least 2 field permissions are stored
proofs.pim.screen-layouts.product-edit-layout: exactly one active layout with a tab names the product edit screen by its full type name, Dynamicweb.Products.UI.Screens.ProductEditScreen, and no active layout carries a short or misspelt product edit screen type (stored, never applied)
proofs.pim.screen-layouts.editors-resolve: every editor named CategoryFields|ProductCategory|<category>|<field> on the layout matches a stored category field, and the layout places at least one. Editors with any other name (standard fields such as Name or Weight, global custom fields, completeness rules) are counted and not judged: their names are defined by the platform, not by a table
proofs.pim.screen-layouts.family-tabs: every category field of every declared family is on the layout, on a tab that carries that one family's fields and nothing else, so the tab shows on that family's products and on no other. Offenders: a family with fields on no tab, a tab that mixes two families, a tab that carries a family's fields together with standard fields, shared-category fields or the catch-all group. A category that is not a declared family is a shared category and is not held to this
proofs.pim.screen-layouts.tabs-per-product: no family's product shows more than 5 tabs: the shared tabs (every tab that carries no declared family's field) plus the tabs that carry that family's fields
proofs.pim.screen-layouts.scannable: no group holds more than 12 editors and no tab more than 30
proofs.pim.screen-layouts.editor-words: no tab or group is named after the mechanism: not a name on the banned list, not a category id, not a name with an underscore, ending in Attrs or containing the words attributes, data model, category fields, custom fields or misc. Every tab and group has a name. The catch-all group is exempt (it may be called Other fields)
proofs.pim.screen-layouts.one-catch-all: the layout has exactly one catch-all group, so a field that is placed nowhere still has one place on the screen
proofs.pim.screen-layouts.unique-group-names: no two groups on the layout share a name, on the same tab or on different tabs
proofs.pim.screen-layouts.division-stated: the build file's editLayout states how the shared fields are divided (role, task, lifecycle or source) and why; when it declares tabs, every declared tab is on the layout, every layout tab is declared, a tab declared shared carries no family's field and a tab declared for a category carries that category's fields only. Whether the division is a good one is not judged
proofs.pim.screen-layouts.preset: at least one list preset has 3 or more columns
proofs.pim.screen-layouts.ruling.one-category-w: the number of attribute categories that carry fields, plus 1 when the largest has more than 25 fields, is at most 1
proofs.pim.channels.channels-with-products: at least one channel has a group that holds products
proofs.pim.channels.shared-groups: no group is shared between two shops or channels

proofs.pim.feeds.template-content-type: every template feed states a content type

proofs.pim.assortments.permissions: at least one assortment is granted to a user or group that exists
proofs.pim.assortments.built: the assortments were built (assortment items exist)
